description: This file handles subpanel quick edit functionality within SuiteCRM modules, dynamically including appropriate classes based on configuration and request parameters, and initiating the quick edit view or subpanel quick edit view as needed.

classes.name: "{$target_module}QuickCreate"
classes.description: A class for quick create view override for a specific module, dynamically instantiated if a custom quick create file exists.

classes.name: "SubpanelQuickEdit"
classes.description: Default class handling subpanel quick edit functionality, instantiated if no custom override is present.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Initiates the processing of the quick create or subpanel quick edit view, depending on the context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the quick create view output.
